WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity,
         ea.avg_humidity - am.mean_humidity AS above_all_mean
  FROM equipment_averages AS ea
  CROSS JOIN all_equipment_mean AS am
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND am.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > am.mean_humidity
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.equipref,
       aa.avg_humidity,
       aa.above_all_mean,
       aa.avg_humidity - gm.mean_humidity AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS gm
WHERE gm.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
